'''''Cynoglossum creticum''''' is a plant in the family [[Boraginaceae]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Bojnanský |first=Vít |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Atlas_of_Seeds_and_Fruits_of_Central_and/QSMe0qHGVaAC?hl=en&gbpv=0 |title=Atlas of Seeds and Fruits of Central and East-European Flora: The Carpathian Mountains Region |last2=Fargašová |first2=Agáta |date=2007-09-17 |publisher=Springer Science & Business Media |isbn=978-1-4020-5362-7 |pages=559 |language=en}}</ref>

It is native to the [[Mediterranean Basin]], including the island of [[Crete]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Fielding |first=John |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Flowers_of_Crete/RSslAQAAMAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=0&bsq=%22Cynoglossum%20creticum%22%20-wikipedia%20crete |title=Flowers of Crete |date=2005 |publisher=Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |isbn=978-1-84246-079-5 |pages=94 |language=en}}</ref>  It is also found as an invasive plant in the US states of [[Texas]] and [[Missouri]], where it is known as '''blue hound's tongue'''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=''Cynoglossum creticum'' |url=https://texasinvasives.org/plant_database/detail.php?symbol=CYCR11 |access-date=2025-03-04 |website=Texas Invasives}}</ref>
